bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
ci_package=44838974338
source=641e5b8b599a6457dddfccf256c9316d9c361d0a
test "$(gh run view "$ci_package" -R seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot --json headSha,conclusion --jq '.headSha+" "+.conclusion')" = "$source success" || exit 60
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = true || exit 61
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = "$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:profile-five-5598)" || exit 62
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 63
tmp="$(mktemp -d /tmp/gace-profile-stdin-dry.XXXXXXXX)"
trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT
gh run download "$ci_package" -R seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot -n gaybbs-profile-bundle -D "$tmp" >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 64
test -s "$tmp/backfillExistingProfileKeyboards.mjs" || exit 65
docker run --rm --network none -v "$tmp:/bundle:ro" --entrypoint node gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:profile-five-5598 --check /bundle/backfillExistingProfileKeyboards.mjs >/dev/null || exit 66
result="$(docker exec -i deploy-gaybbs-1 node --import /app/preload/telegram-ipv4-preload.mjs --input-type=module - --dry-run < "$tmp/backfillExistingProfileKeyboards.mjs")" || exit 67
printf '%s\n' "$result"
printf '%s\n' "$result" | grep -Fq '"mode":"--dry-run"' || exit 68
printf '%s\n' "$result" | grep -Fq '"existing_posts":7' || exit 69
printf '%s\n' "$result" | grep -Fq '"applied":0' || exit 70
printf '%s\n' "$result" | grep -Fq '"uncertain":0' || exit 71
echo PROFILE_READONLY_STDIN_DRY_RUN=PASS
echo PROFILE_EXISTING_POSTS_MUTATED=NONE
echo GAYBBS_ROOTFS_READONLY=PRESERVED
